# Markdown release notes

- Marked 18.1.3: `marked.umd.js`, MIT; unchanged browser build from the pinned npm package. Source: https://github.com/markedjs/marked/tree/v18.1.3
- DOMPurify 3.4.17: `purify.min.js`, Apache-2.0 option; unchanged browser build from the pinned npm package. Source: https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify/tree/3.4.17

License texts accompany both libraries. Release notes are parsed locally, then sanitized to read-only Markdown elements before insertion. No CDN or additional network access is used by the WebView.
